# Tanish Anand

> Personal portfolio of Tanish Anand — developer, founder, and researcher building at the intersection of AI, hardware, and the web. Founder of CareLink, creator of Project Rudra, Research Fellow at IIT Kanpur.

## About

Tanish Anand is a builder and researcher working at the intersection of AI, hardware, and the web. He is the founder of CareLink and the developer of Project Rudra. He is currently a Research Fellow at IIT Kanpur under Prof. Adithya Vadapalli.
